---
title: inif.io
description: Save and load INIF documents — suffix-based dispatch plus the unified read API for both .inif and .inif.json.
reference: inif.io
---

`save` and `load` are the two-way entry points; both dispatch on the path
suffix (`.inif` ⇒ indexed archive, `.inif.json` ⇒ plain JSON). The
unified read API (`iter_samples`, `read_samples`, `read_info`) abstracts
over the same dispatch, so callers don't need to branch on file format.
For the indexed-archive writer and lower-level options see
[`inif.indexed`](inif.indexed.qmd).
